title: Feature chain
lede: How a feature idea becomes a reviewed, tested PR. The owner decides intent and authorizes merges; the agent does the rest.

design.name: Design
design.role: Agree on what to build and why, one question at a time.
details: The agent explores the code first and only asks what the code can't answer, each time with a recommended answer.
Resumes at the first missing artifact in `docs/<slug>/`, or at the first incomplete slice when plan.md exists; a supplied document is placed as design.md.

more: Decisions with rationale, canonical vocabulary, edge cases.

qs: What makes a design question worth asking the owner instead of deciding?

prd.name: PRD
prd.role: Turn the design into user stories and testing decisions, without re-interviewing.
details: Cross-checks the design against the codebase and confirms with the owner which modules need tests.

tdd.name: TDD slices
tdd.role: Build in thin vertical slices: failing test, minimal code, refactor, commit.
details: Granularity is confirmed once with the owner; after that, an interface change is surfaced only if it departs from plan.md, and a large fix is always surfaced.
risks: Writing all tests first verifies imagined behavior; one test at a time keeps them honest.

refine.name: Refine
refine.role: Two independent reviewers (correctness, structure) report; one pass applies every fix.
details: A test weakened to pass counts as a defect, not a fix.

qa.name: QA
qa.role: Run the real app, drive the changed entry points the way a user would, and fix what breaks.
details: Skipped, with the reason recorded, when the change has no runtime entry point.

review.name: Owner review
review.role: Give the owner a summary, then stop for review or, for a queued task, open its PR; merge only with authority.
details: Merging needs explicit owner authorization; a PR is not approval. Without it, a queued task keeps its ready PR and the next task waits.

prd.d: Product requirements document: the problem, the solution and the user stories.

slice.d: A piece of a feature that cuts through every layer: data, logic, UI and tests.

ask.context: The reader wants to understand scaffold's feature chain: how an AI agent takes a feature from idea to reviewed PR.
